coordinates.object_orientation: +Z from aperture/base to apex; front camera -Y. Aperture centre toward (+X,-Y) so it appears lower-right in frontal view. Dextral shell when apex up and aperture viewed from front; base near Z=0.

concept.reason: Named fossil photograph supplies front and back views with scale and visible aperture; historical figure and description corroborate tower geometry. Additional synthetic concept adds no evidence. No prior denied image-generation operation is bypassed.

name: Turritella many-whorled tower snail fossil study
target: Preserve original genus-level fossil-form target: long tapering tower, numerous rounded tightly stacked whorls, and a real rounded basal aperture.

reference_specimen.current_name: Turritella perexilis (subannulata treated as synonym by WoRMS)
reference_specimen.scope: Evidence-informed low-poly fossil-shell study based on a named specimen; not a scan, exact specimen replica, living snail, or scene reconstruction.
reference_specimen.period: Species has Pliocene–Pleistocene fossil occurrences and survives today under perexilis; do NOT call it extinct. UF181437 exact age/locality is not supplied on atlas page. Neogene is a representative taxon interval, not dated specimen provenance.
reference_specimen.taxonomic_caution: Friend et al. 2023 retain perexilis in Turritella sensu lato (quoted genus), not confidently assigned to a newly resolved genus. WoRMS uses Turritella. This asset is a traditional genus-level fossil-form study, no claim of resolved monophyly.

must_have: One continuous dextral high-spired shell, not a stack of disconnected tori
About 12–14 visibly differentiated whorls, progressively smaller towards a narrow apex
Gently rounded whorl bulk with a modest keel/band, shallow but readable sutures, not a straight cone with painted stripes
Last body whorl only moderately expanded; rounded-subquadrate terminal aperture with subtly flatter base, facing front-right
Aperture has a thin rim and recessed inner wall; not a black decal or solid plug
Convex base and continuous columellar-side attachment of aperture
A few low-amplitude axial undulations on upper halves of major whorls: distinguish broad wavy growth from microscopic scratch detail; do not add spines.
must_not_have: No animal tissue, operculum, tentacles, substrate or museum writing
No long siphonal canal, wide trumpet lip, spikes or six-rib tusk-shell shape
Do not add a missing top whorl or claim exact protoconch anatomy; preserve simplified visible pointed end
No copied reference mesh, projected photo texture or traced photographic damage
morphology.simplification: Retain whorl silhouette, modest keel, broad upper-whorl axial undulations and aperture. Omit microscopic lines and high-frequency scratch texture. Do not overstate deeply incised sutures or a pure circular aperture.

scale.source: Approximate image-based inference from UF181437 2 cm scale strip; not a direct specimen measurement.
scale.other_specimen_measurement: Heilprin original figure states 1.2 inches length and .25 inch width; these refer to that different figured specimen, not UF181437, and are not mixed into its dimensions.

acceptance_focus: Front: right-hand aperture and tapering stepped tower are readable
Side: body-whorl depth and recessed aperture have real geometry
Top: dextral coil and aperture orientation agree with front
Perspective: long slender tower, rounded whorls and unobstructed aperture remain identifiable at card size
Mesh has intentional shell thickness at opening, no cracks between independently stacked rings and no accidental open surface seams
evidence_limits: Back/side proportions and interior depth require modest geometric interpolation; no photogrammetric accuracy claim
No underside or interior tomography exists in selected source; model only a short recessed vestibule, not invented full internal chambers
Photographic tone is fossil mineral colour, not live coloration; material is an artistic neutral bone-beige
maker_workflow: 3–4 cheap gray views before final render; store checks in private/
Four final views required: front, side, top, perspective; perspective may equal preview
Use deterministic generator and self-contained source/deps if helpers are required; record hashes and exact runtime
Two isolated rebuilds and actual GLB/Khronos checks remain required; prep/helper handoff check is not QA
Keep same localdir through maker and independent QA; notify root and FINAL after maker, no upload/cleanup
